title: Willow Gardens — Revised
subtitle: Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence.

sections.heading: What changed in this revision
paragraphs: Effective 2026-09-01, the revised certified rent roll supersedes the prior roll. Suite 053 converted from pending to active, and its monthly rent increased by $225 to $1,950. The capitalization rate increased by 25 bps (to 6.25%), and the initial sizing rate increased by 75 bps (to 7.65%). All other underwriting rules, expenses, and payoff remain unchanged. The analysis preserves all unaffected facts and the approved sentence above.

rows: Higher cap rate offsets NOI gain
Higher sizing rate reduces DSCR sizing

sections.heading: Executive summary (revised)
paragraphs: As of 2026-09-01, Willow Gardens is a 64-unit multifamily property in San Antonio, TX. Certified in-place count shows 49 active, 4 pending (not yet in possession), and 11 vacant suites. Underwriting applies the updated all-suite scheduled GPR from the revised roll, 5% economic loss, and $350 per unit annual other income. Taxes, insurance, other operating expenses, management fee, and reserves per unit are applied per instruction. Valuation now capitalizes NOI before reserves at 6.25%. Debt is sized to the tightest of 60% LTV, 1.25x DSCR at the greater of the 7.65% sizing rate (note vs. floor) and the 6.00% floor, and 9.0% debt yield.

Result: UW EGI $1,311,740; UW NOI before reserves $893,128; UW NCF $873,928; value $14.29MM at 6.25% cap; maximum loan $8.21MM; net cash out after 1% fee, $45k closing, and $7.20MM payoff: approximately $0.88MM positive.

sections.heading: Property and unit mix (unchanged)
paragraphs: 64 suites: 22 Studios (820 SF), 21 1BR (940 SF), 21 2BR (1,150 SF). Total NRA 61,930 SF. Manager’s headline continues to include pending within leased; certified detail controls physical occupancy metrics.

sections.heading: Lease and occupancy analysis (revised)
paragraphs: Certified as of 2026-09-01: 49 active, 4 pending, 11 vacant. Physical unit occupancy is 49/64 = 76.56%. Area occupancy increases accordingly by one 1BR unit (940 SF). All expirations remain 2029-08-31; no near-term rollover. Suite 001 remains at $1,575; correspondence still indicates no amendments or concessions as of 2026-08-31 and the revision notice did not alter Suite 001.

rows: Updated for one more 940 SF active

sections.heading: Historical vs underwritten financials (revised)
paragraphs: T12 history unchanged. Underwritten EGI adjusts to the revised GPR: $113,100/mo × 12 = $1,357,200 GPR, less 5% economic loss and plus $350/unit other income to arrive at EGI $1,311,740. Management fee is 3% of EGI ($39,352). UW NOI before reserves is $893,128; reserves remain $19,200; UW NCF $873,928. Valuation now uses a 6.25% cap rate.

sections.heading: Debt sizing and sources/uses (revised)
paragraphs: Constraints: 60% LTV on cap value $14.29MM, 1.25x DSCR at 7.65%/30yr, 9% debt yield. Binding constraint is DSCR at the higher sizing rate. Maximum loan $8.21MM. Net cash out decreases to ≈$0.88MM after the 1% origination fee, $45k closing costs, and $7.20MM payoff.

sections.heading: Risks and open diligence items (unchanged)
paragraphs:
- Pending counted as leased in manager headline remains present; physical occupancy excludes pending.
- Near-term rollover remains absent (all expirations 2029-08-31).
- Insurance evidence remains present; policy aggregate $2,000,000 through 2027-06-30.
- Capital-in-opex risk remains absent (roof replacement capitalized).
- Unsigned rent change proposals absent.
- Sizing floor not binding (7.65% sizing rate above 6.00% floor).
- Refinance shortfall absent at revised max loan (net cash out still positive).

sections.heading: Source notes (revised)
paragraphs: New sources: revision-notice.pdf (instruction changes), rent-roll-revised.xlsx (as-of 2026-09-01; Unit 053 details). All other citations unchanged from the original OM. Workbook includes an updated Sources-Rev sheet.
